name: Extra Lineage Domain
body:
You have learned the secret of tapping into your divine bloodline.

Prerequisite: Lineage domain class feature.

Benefit: You gain access to an additional cleric domain or subdomain granted by your lineage domain class feature.

Special: A godling can select this feat as one of her bonus feats or as a scion talent.
